home.intro: We build and service bicycles in the heart of Pécs, on Hegyalja utca. City commuter, road race machine or trail MTB — the details matter.
home.aboutTitle: We don't just fix bikes. We build experiences.
home.aboutBody: Dreamline Cycle is a full-service bicycle workshop and custom build studio. Whether you need an everyday city bike, a road race machine or an MTB for the trails, you can count on us for servicing, advice and a genuinely special bicycle.
home.aboutQuote: A good bicycle isn't made of the most expensive parts. It's made of the parts that fit best.
home.servicesIntro: From a full service to one-off wheels. Everything is done in-house, by hand, with warranty.
home.galleryIntro: Custom builds, hand-built wheels and everyday workshop life. The gallery updates from a folder — new photo, new story.
home.processTitle: From first sketch to first ride
home.processIntro: Four steps, zero templates. Every bike is built for your measurements and your roads.
home.blogIntro: Build logs, workshop secrets and practical advice for your bike.
home.contactTitle: Bring it in. Let's talk. Let's build it.
home.contactBody: Bring your bike by, or write a few lines about what you're dreaming of. A custom build always starts with a conversation.
home.contactNote: Before visiting in person, please call to check available slots and current opening hours.

services.title: Everything that happens around your bike
services.intro: From routine servicing to a completely one-off build. Nothing leaves the workshop until it feels right to ride.
services.listIntro: Seven services, one workshop. Call us if you're unsure — we're happy to point you in the right direction.

services.bookText: The quickest way is to call. We'll work out when you can drop the bike off and how long the job will take.
